Marta P.: FYI I repro'd a perf cliff on SM90 nodes when prefetch_enabled=true for paged-fusion/fused-attn.
Kevin L.: ugh, how big is the cliff?
Marta P.: microbench (long seq ~8k, batch=1): SM75 CUDA11.8 native kernels -> ~85ms/token; SM90 CUDA12.1 Triton fused -> ~210ms/token.
Chandra R.: that's huge. Did you check whether it's falling back to the slow paged path or a kernel mismatch?
Marta P.: yeah, looks like runtime selected the tiled-fused kernel, but kernel returns a small-op codepath that forces serialized prefetchs. The trace shows a huge number of small kernel launches.
Marta P.: Paste from nvprof summary:
```
GPU activities:  kernel:  1.23s  74.1%  1000  tiled_fused_kernel
GPU activities:  kernel:  0.95s  57.2%   980  kv_prefetch_step
GPU activities:  kernel:  0.10s   6.0%   980  small_meta_copy
```
Kevin L.: looks like the prefetch loop is iterating per tile instead of batching across tiles. Any difference if you force the CUDA kernel instead of Triton?
Marta P.: good call. Forcing cuda path (env KERNEL_IMPL=CUDA_FORCE) -> 98ms/token on SM90. So problem is Triton kernel codegen + SM90 L2 behavior.
Chandra R.: could be new L2 caching behavior on A100->H100 arch interactions causing different memory pressure so our tiled collector falls back. Have you tried toggling PREFETCH_STRIDE or increasing kv_cache_segment?
Marta P.: fiddled with PREFETCH_STRIDE=4 -> small improvement to 180ms/token. Increasing kv_cache_segment hits memory limit.
Emily S.: perf-bot flagged CI perf regression on nightly runs for paged-fusion on SM90, see: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/1234 (perf-bot:regression).
perf-bot: CI run 2026-02-15: paged-fusion longseq SM90 mean latency +2.5x vs baseline.
Kevin L.: mitigation options: 1) disable prefetch on SM90 until we fix Triton kernel; 2) force CUDA kernels for paged-fusion on SM90; 3) tweak batching heuristics to avoid the tiled path for long seqs.
Chandra R.: option 2 seems lowest risk but loses Triton perf wins elsewhere. Option 1 is easiest for now.
Marta P.: I'll open a canary to disable prefetch on SM90 pool and add a chokepoint to force CUDA kernel for the specific model family.
Marta P.: quick rollout plan: add runtime flag runtime/attn_selector/strategy=forced_cuda_for_sm90_paged in canary (10% traffic), monitor token latency and KV hit rate.
Emily S.: canary is fine. Also add a metric alert for kernel launch count (per-request) so we can detect tiny-launch storms.
Kevin L.: note: disabling prefetch reduces memory overhead but can increase tail latency for certain prompts; flag must be per-model-version.
Marta P.: opened PR: https://gitlab.redwood/redwood/runtime/merge_requests/789 (WIP) - will include test and perf benchmark.
Chandra R.: assign me to the kernel bisect. I'll try to identify whether a specific Triton commit or nvcc upgrade triggers optimizer to emit the serialized prefetch loop.
Marta P.: thanks. Will post updated microbench results here after canary.
Kevin L.: also add a short note to eng-runtime/README about this behavior so oncall knows what to toggle.
Emily S.: emoji :thumbsup: planning to monitor today's canary.
perf-bot: adding perf regression label and alert rule draft at infra/alerts/paged-fusion-sm90.json
Marta P.: TL;DR: Triton path + SM90 L2/cache interaction created serialized prefetch -> 2x+ latency. Canary: disable prefetch on SM90 or force CUDA path until kernel patch.
